name: Alphabet (Google)

source.quote: As of June 30, 2026, we had $519.5 billion of remaining performance obligations (“revenue backlog”), of which $513.9 billion related to Google Cloud.

description: Parent of Google; builds Gemini AI models and rents its own TPU AI chips and other computing power through Google Cloud.
explain: Google Cloud sells computing power, especially its in-house TPU chips, to AI labs such as Anthropic and Meta. Its contracted backlog jumped past $500 billion in 2026 as those labs signed huge multi-year deals. The backlog figure here is the Google Cloud portion.
